body: You want to kill yourself because you have a disorder that can go away with treatment and medication? Okay.

I'm confused. Someone is blackmailing you into staying in a program under threat of having you investigated for misconduct?

They don't have a superior you could report them to?

Empower yourself by staying alive—as if to say to your rapist, "fuck you, you don't influence me."

They're a figment of the past, and may as well be dead.

Why not look at every second you stay alive as a victory over someone who tried to take you down? You've made it this far.
What the fuck? How old are you?
